verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents task worktrees, remote daemon hosts, and bring-your-own compute, but nothing about a sandbox or test environment that keeps agent work away from production data. Worktrees isolate code checkouts, not data or services. The remote-daemon docs actually advise picking a host that can reach credentials and private services, which is not sandbox isolation. Dry-run or sandbox modes are not evidenced at all.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
